def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0

    N = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    stock = {}
    for i in range(1, M + 1):
        for j in range(1, N + 1):
            stock[(i, j)] = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    P = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    sold = 0

        i = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        j = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        if stock.get((i, j), 0) > 0:
            stock[(i, j)] -= 1
            sold += 1
    print(sold)
